observed_sources.evidence: As of 19 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reported a total of 9 552 confirmed cases, including 4 602 related deaths (from data up until 18 October)

counts.outcome: Fresh direct extraction shows CDC 9,637/4,646 while ECDC remains 9,552/4,602. The source dates are not equivalent: CDC still labels 2026-10-20, while ECDC is a 2026-10-19 report with data through 2026-10-18. The required CDC/ECDC equality gate therefore failed, and the complete prior canonical bundle was retained without advancing revision, publication time, outbreak dates, or verification.checked_at.

source_delivery_review.outcome: CDC direct parsing and public official-page content agree on 9,637/4,646. ECDC direct parsing and public official-page content agree on 9,552/4,602; its page says it was last updated 2026-10-20 at 15:00 but still uses DRC data through 2026-10-18. This is a cross-publisher synchronization conflict, not a connectivity-only check.

who_review.outcome: WHO External Situation Report 23 body content reports DRC 9,637 confirmed cases and 4,646 confirmed deaths as of 2026-10-19. This corroborates the newer CDC value but does not satisfy the repository contract's mandatory CDC/ECDC equality gate, so it was recorded as evidence and not promoted.

drc_review.outcome: No newer INSP SitRep content could be independently retrieved and content-verified in this audit. A reachable or indexed URL alone was not treated as verified evidence. The previous verified DRC snapshot remains retained.

research_history_review.outcome: WHO's current outbreak overview still states there is no licensed Bundibugyo vaccine or specific treatment. No verified research/history wording change requiring publication was identified. Population/displacement remains unimplemented pending a versioned official dataset and definition.
